serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: I’m not exactly thrilled by the idea since {f_botName} instead of singing, is just copying the original voice line from the song, but I couldn’t really refuse. You: Listen, {f_botName}. This time Annalie will be with us, so could you sing a little worse than the last time? We wouldn't want her to be suspicious of you, right? You: After all, you already are a god in bowling. Being perfect in everything would be a big giveaway. Bot: Sure, no problem.
